method: Exact same-food CoFID/BLS/USDA values are preferred. Close profiles are scaled only when total-fat difference is small. Remaining plant-only foods receive a documented composition-based trans-fat zero only when no animal fat or partially hydrogenated fat is named. Estimates and replacements are explicit below.

source.method: Exact CoFID total PUFA is 0.15 g. The close tzatziki source reports ALA/EPA/DHA as zero, so the total is assigned to n-6.

Exact same-style CoFID entry with identical total fat. It replaces the lower-match BLS ALA value 0.0292 with the exact-profile ALA value 0.06; EPA/DHA trace markers remain stored as zero at database precision.
Scale the close USDA n-6 profile by target/source fat (7.2/6.3). CoFID reports trans marker N, meaning present but not reliably quantified; 0.10 g is a coarse estimate, not zero.
source.confidence: medium-low for omega-6; low for trans

source.method: Close exact-grain and preparation match, scaled by total fat ratio 0.9/0.97. USDA directly reports trans fat as 0.
Exact same-food and total-fat match. Existing BLS omega values are preserved; CoFID is used only to fill the missing trans-fat value.
Use exact CoFID trans fat and scale the USDA omega profile by total-fat ratio 15.3/14.1. Omega-3 equals the sum of the already stored ALA, EPA and DHA values.
Exact same cereal-type and fat profile; the CoFID trace trans marker is stored as zero at database precision. Exact CoFID ALA replaces the lower-match USDA comparator value.

Retain USDA ALA as n-3 and derive n-6 as the remaining CoFID total PUFA (2.0 - 0.275). EPA/DHA are zero in the close USDA profile. This resolves an internal mismatch in the USDA record between total PUFA and its listed individual fatty acids.
Exact matching retail sausage roll with identical total fat. Trace EPA/DHA markers are stored as zero at database precision.

Exact food and total-fat match; directly reported linoleic acid and trans-fat zero.
Close dry mature-bean profile with 4.6% total-fat difference. Replaces the prior BLS formula-zero with the USDA profile; scale ALA and LA by 1.6/1.53.
